async def act(page):
    # Log in to the Magento Admin panel
    username_field = page.get_by_role('textbox', name='Username *')
    await username_field.fill('admin')  # Assuming default admin username
    # Locate the password field; it might be a textbox or other role, but typically 'Password *' in name
    password_field = page.get_by_role('textbox', name='Password *')
    await password_field.fill('admin123')  # Assuming default password
    # Click the sign-in button; ensure it's located correctly
    sign_in_button = page.get_by_role('button', name='Sign in')
    await sign_in_button.click()
    # Wait for navigation to complete after login
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # Navigate to the Manage Customers page to show all customers
    await page.goto('/index.php/admin/customer/')
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
